builds.name: Reference: Ranked top core
builds.goal: Reference for Rumble: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ top players use most (1,657 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 54.1% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A Heat-managed magic brawler who holds enemies in flames and deliberately chooses when to enter the spell-lockout attack window. The current top provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Liandry's Torment → Bloodletter's Curse → Zhonya's Hourglass. Deathfire Touch keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Sorcerer's Shoes, Rabadon's Deathcap, Morellonomicon.
builds.summary: The proven top baseline: Liandry's Torment → Bloodletter's Curse → Zhonya's Hourglass, with Deathfire Touch.
testPlan: Play it in top as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Liandry's Torment → Bloodletter's Curse → Zhonya's Hourglass) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 54.1% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Liandry's Torment → Bloodletter's Curse → Zhonya's Hourglass.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.
builds.author: Rift Build Lab ranked data

kitEvidence.formula:
Rumble tosses up a barrier, gaining [25 / 55 / 85 / 115 / 145 + (0.3) × AP + (0.04) × Stat(12)] Shield for @ShieldDuration.1@ seconds and [(0.1 / 0.15 / 0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3) × 100]% Move Speed for [1] second.

Danger Zone: The barrier grants [(25 / 55 / 85 / 115 / 145 + (0.3) × AP + (0.04) × Stat(12)) × (1.5)] Shield and [(0.1 / 0.15 / 0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3) × (1.5)] Move Speed instead.

Rumble ignites his flamethrower, dealing [50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (1.05) × AP] plus [(0.06 / 0.065 / 0.07 / 0.075 / 0.08) × 100]% max Health magic damage over [3] seconds, reduced to [70]% against minions.

Danger Zone: Damage is increased to [(50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (1.05) × AP) × (1.5)] plus [(0.06 / 0.065 / 0.07 / 0.075 / 0.08) × (1.5)] max Health.

Percent damage is limited to [characterLevelInterpolation(65 → 300; raw flags preserved)] damage on Monsters.

Rumble launches an electrified harpoon, dealing [55 / 80 / 105 / 130 / 155 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage, Slowing by [15 / 20 / 25 / 30 / 35]% for [2] seconds, and reducing the enemy's Magic Resist by [(0.1 / 0.12 / 0.14 / 0.16 / 0.18) × 100]% for [4] seconds.

Hitting an enemy who's already Slowed by this Ability increases the Slow to [30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 70]% and reduces the enemy's Magic Resist by [(0.2 / 0.24 / 0.28 / 0.32 / 0.36) × 100]%

Danger Zone: The harpoon deals [(55 / 80 / 105 / 130 / 155 + (0.5) × AP) × (1.5)] magic damage instead and the Slow and reduced Magic Resist are increased by 50%.

Rumble launches a line of rockets, creating a burning trail that lasts [4.5] seconds, Slowing by [35]% and dealing [120 / 200 / 280 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage per second.

Rumble can control the direction of the trail by clicking and dragging while casting this Ability.

Rumble's Abilities generate Heat. While above [50] Heat, he enters the Danger Zone, causing his basic Abilities to gain bonus effects. When he reaches [150] Heat, he overheats for [4] seconds. 

While overheated, Rumble Silences himself, but gains [characterLevelInterpolation(0.3 → 1; raw flags preserved)] Attack Speed and causes his Attacks to deal an additional [characterLevelInterpolation(5 → 40; raw flags preserved) + (0.25) × AP] plus [4]% max Health magic damage.

Percent damage is limited to [characterLevelInterpolation(90 → 175; raw flags preserved)] damage on Monsters.

builds.name: Overheat hand-off
builds.summary: Move from Danger Zone spell damage into the four-second attack phase.
builds.goal: Move from Danger Zone spell damage into the four-second attack phase.
builds.hypothesis: The passive record overheats at 150 Heat, silencing casts but adding attack speed, 0.25 AP attack damage and target-health magic damage. Nashor and Rageblade test the attack hand-off; W's AP/health shield and Cosmic movement support staying in range.
testPlan: Required state: Recorded Heat, Q already running and W applied before overheat silences casts.
Record Heat threshold and Q persistence, then passive/Nashor packets during four seconds with Rageblade ramp recorded.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Reaching overheat before defensive setup or being kited loses the brief attack phase.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The passive summary's 100% wording does not override the detailed record's 150 Heat threshold.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Riftmaker, Cosmic Drive, Rabadon's Deathcap, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Magic matchup
builds.goal: Situational adaptation for Rumble: adapt to the specified fight rather than assume one universal build
builds.hypothesis: A Heat-managed magic brawler who holds enemies in flames and deliberately chooses when to enter the spell-lockout attack window. Fix Heat and overheat state. The spell-lockout attack window differs from normal casting; AP/attack speed must be measured without keeping unavailable spells active. MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure.
builds.summary: MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure.
testPlan: Kit question for Rumble: Fix Heat and overheat state. The spell-lockout attack window differs from normal casting; AP/attack speed must be measured without keeping unavailable spells active.

Start with the early core (Hollow Radiance or other MR first when justified) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Compare against the reference route at the same level, gold spent, finite stacks and opponent setup. Record unused gold; isolate an item change before changing runes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Heat. Do not treat mana regeneration as Heat recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: MR and nearby magic amplification test durable contact against magic pressure. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern. Choose the opponent profile this defensive route is intended to address, then repeat against the wrong damage type.

Q evidence: Rumble torches opponents in front of him, dealing magic damage in a cone for 3 seconds. While in Danger Zone this damage is increased. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: MR is wasted against the wrong threat; nearby aura range and healing eligibility matter.

The route fails Rumble's stated kit question: Fix Heat and overheat state. The spell-lockout attack window differs from normal casting; AP/attack speed must be measured without keeping unavailable spells active.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: MR is wasted against the wrong threat; nearby aura range and healing eligibility matter.
Full cost 15,600 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
Counter-items are conditional. Change boots/defense for the real matchup, then record the modified setup.
buyOrder: Hollow Radiance or other MR first when justified. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Abyssal Mask, Spirit Visage, Jak'Sho, The Protean are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: Heat. Do not treat mana regeneration as Heat recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

builds.name: Harpoon shred burn
builds.summary: Use two connected harpoons to increase the value of a retained burn zone.
builds.goal: Use two connected harpoons to increase the value of a retained burn zone.
builds.hypothesis: E's second hit against its own slow increases MR reduction, with Danger Zone amplifying that effect. Bloodletter tests additional magic resistance reduction from ability/passive damage while Liandry and R require sustained target contact. Cosmic assists aiming and following the Q cone.
testPlan: Required state: Both E hits connect during the slow, Danger Zone state recorded and target remains on R.
Measure MR and Q/R damage after zero, one and two E hits, separately recording Bloodletter stacks.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Missed second harpoon or early zone escape defeats both shred and sustained burn.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: MR reduction and percentage penetration cannot be added as a single simple percentage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Bloodletter's Curse, Liandry's Torment, Cosmic Drive, Rabadon's Deathcap, Zhonya's Hourglass, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
